notes.title: 🔔 Important Update: The Stones Is No Longer Free to Play!
notes.content:
We wanted to let you know that The Stones will no longer be available as a free-to-play game. Starting May 9th, the game will be priced at $0.99.

This small price tag helps us continue supporting development, adding new content, and improving the overall experience for you. We’re grateful to everyone who joined us during the free period — your feedback and support means a lot.

— Kovik Studios
